summary: Tabs feature implemented but not run; all verification was by reading code. Added src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs; Tabs has DEFAULT_STYLES "height: 2;" and can_focus=True). UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) and now yields one Text with click spans last. Opacity blends only color, preserving meta. Layout resolver unchanged (Edge protocol already has size/min_size/fraction). Added docs/reference/tabs.md, new tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py, and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py. Deviations: bar position is in displayed-tab index space (needed for duplicate names, criterion 11) rather than find_tab_by_name's full index; zero-width labels omit the label edge; multi-character keys skip letter search; Escape makes the bare un-awaited set_focus call per spec (emits a never-awaited warning). Sandbox demo skipped as optional. Nothing committed.
